This was the first more sprawling game I've played in a couple of months, and I really consistently enjoyed it. The story wasn't groundbreaking but I did enjoy the somewhat different take on shunning the Rebels as just another syndicate. I loved Nix (foodie, collector axolotl), the stealth and combat were pretty well done, and the number of things to do kept me coming back (mostly being played above my sleeping infant's head post-feeds). I also appreciated little touches like being able to annotate things you'd found on the map. Summoning the speeder was awful, there were bugs, and some bits were just frustrating, but overall I'm quite sad I'm done with this.
